title: First-Default Relief for Families with a Steady Payment History
content:
# First-Default Relief for Families with a Steady Payment History

Terms for families on a Medicaid Managed Care Membership whose CHIP membership ended for unpaid premiums.

## Term

The first-default relief follows the family's payment history: where at least the steady-history minimum of premium payments posted in the history months before the review date and no financial hardship waiver posted in that time, the relief is the full first-default relief; where at least that many payments posted and a financial hardship waiver also posted in that time, the relief is the partial first-default relief; otherwise there is no first-default relief.

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Steady-history minimum | 8 premium payments |
| History months | the 18 months before the review date |
| Full first-default relief | $10.00 |
| Partial first-default relief | $5.00 |

The relief is taken off the lockout balance.

## What is counted

- Premium payments posted on the membership's premium account in the 18 months before the review date, by posted date, whatever the payment method.
- Premium waivers with the reason financial hardship posted in those same 18 months. A waiver for any other reason is not a financial hardship waiver.

## Tiers

| Payments posted in the 18 months | Financial hardship waiver posted in the 18 months | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| 8 or more | none | $10.00 |
| 8 or more | one or more | $5.00 |
| 7 or fewer | any | none |

## History cases (hypothetical)

1. *Hypothetical:* 8 payments and no waiver in the 18 months: $10.00.
2. *Hypothetical:* 11 payments and one financial hardship waiver in the 18 months: $5.00.
3. *Hypothetical:* 7 payments and no waiver: no first-default relief.
4. *Hypothetical:* 9 payments in the 18 months and a financial hardship waiver posted 20 months before the review date: the waiver lies outside the history months, so $10.00.
